name: code-mentor-backend
description: C#/.NET backend tutoring with guided practice, evidence-linked memory and adaptive teaching in the learner's language.

interface.shortDescription: Learn C# backend step by step
interface.longDescription: A C#/.NET backend tutor that responds in the learner's language. It guides reading, refactoring, debugging and documentation one concept at a time. English text shortcuts retain Spanish aliases. Gradual teaching-aid exploration distinguishes clarity feedback from demonstrated learning. Authorized records require accessible persistent storage and verified writes; otherwise it prepares a pending batch for a user-initiated handoff. Knowledge cards require acceptance. No fixed learning styles, background work or automatic cross-device synchronization. Voice depends on the host. Local utilities need Python 3.11+. Private offline progress reports add clickable practice days, concept filters and historical evidence; opening HTML depends on the host. Private dated notes and Monday–Sunday blocks preserve covered topics, examples and doubts with linked indexes. Memory status, read-only quality audits and goal-specific linked knowledge maps reuse the same authorized record.
defaultPrompt: Help me understand this C# code step by step.
Guide me through debugging this .NET issue.
Help me study C# operators based on what I already know.

prompts: Explain a call between classes, one concept at a time.
Help me debug a 404 response in ASP.NET Core.
Guide me through refactoring a Result consumer.
Use available learning evidence to study C# documentation and propose a knowledge card.
I am struggling with a concept. Review available evidence and choose an aid without assuming a fixed learning style.

publication.release_notes: Adds /week and /semana with evidence-linked Monday–Sunday learning blocks in the existing private notebook. Records concepts/tasks, practice and help, difficulties, teaching aids, sources and next steps. Groups by original occurrence dates and learner time zone, preserves weekly IDs/history, and distinguishes calendar state from capture/learning. Refreshes during active-session saves; no background automation, new evidence store or session counter. Extends bounded memory audits to weekly links/indexing.

es-ES.subtitle: Profesor de C# y .NET
es-ES.description: Profesor de C# y .NET backend en el idioma del alumno, con lectura, refactorización, depuración y documentación paso a paso. Atajos en inglés y alias en español. Explora ayudas gradualmente y distingue claridad de aprendizaje demostrado. Guarda solo con acceso autorizado y verificable; sin escritura, prepara pendientes. Fichas con aceptación, sin estilos fijos, sincronización automática ni trabajo de fondo. Voz según plataforma; utilidades locales con Python 3.11+. Incluye calendario privado pulsable, filtros por concepto y evidencias de logros; la visualización HTML depende del entorno. Añade estado de memoria, auditoría sin cambios y mapas de conocimientos enlazados al registro autorizado. Bloques semanales de lunes a domingo con fuentes, dificultades y siguientes pasos, actualizados durante las sesiones.
